name: Andrzej Halicki, Matjaž Nemec - Après le § 57 - Am 60
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: 57c. Insists that the EU budget must support the defence of peace and disarmament, the UN Charter and international law, sovereignty and democracy, multilateralism, diplomacy and the peaceful resolution of international conflicts, peoples’ rights, human rights and promote a system of collective security for Europe with a view to creating an international order capable of guaranteeing peace and justice in relations between peoples;
